name: Dynamic C - Methanol injection (illustrative)
description: Methanol pump running at the SDU, CIV-301 closed, metering valve CIMV-301 at 60 %. Open CIV-301: the injection rate follows from the available differential; methanol enters the tree bore cavity and travels down the flowline with the production flow. All data ILLUSTRATIVE.
briefing: Check the available differential for methanol in the Chemicals panel, then open CIV-301.
FT-301 responds within seconds; AT-510 (downstream choke) shortly after; AT-511 (2.5 km) and AT-512 (arrival) much later - their delays are V/Q of the flowline.
Note the small change in production pressures and the slight cooling at TT-103 from mixing cold methanol.
